meta.title: Mizan
meta.description: Mizan — the commerce operating system: orders, confirmation, shipping, warehouse and real profit in one place.

home.title: Welcome to Mizan
home.subtitle: Connect your store to see your orders and your real profit in one place.

empty.title: No orders yet
empty.body: Once you connect a Shopify store, we import the last {days} days of orders and all your products.

auth.title: Sign in to Mizan
auth.subtitle: Store owners and admins sign in with email and a code on their phone. Confirmation and warehouse teams can use their phone number.
auth.notConfigured: Sign-in is not configured in this build.
auth.resetSent: We sent a password reset link to <e>{email}</e>.

mfa.title: Second step
mfa.body: We texted a code to the number ending in <n>{hint}</n>.

auth.enrolled: Two-step verification is on. Sign in again with your email and a code.

errors.invalidCredential: That email or password is not right.
errors.emailInUse: This email already has an account. Sign in with it.
errors.weakPassword: That password is too short. Use 8 characters or more.
errors.invalidPhone: That phone number is not valid. Write it like 01001234821.
errors.invalidCode: That code is wrong. Check the message and type it again.
errors.codeExpired: That code expired. Send a new one.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
errors.network: No connection. Check the internet and try again.

twoStep.title: Turn on two-step verification
twoStep.body: To protect your store, owners and admins sign in with email and a code sent to their phone.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email first
verifyEmail.body: We will send a confirmation link to <e>{email}</e>. Open it, then come back here.
verifyEmail.notYet: Your email is not confirmed yet. Open the link in the message.

twoStep.phoneAccount: This account signs in with a phone number. Store owners need an email account to turn on the second step.
twoStep.recentLogin: For your security, sign out, sign in again, then turn on the second step.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.subtitle: Open a store you were invited to, or create your own.

create.title: Create a store
create.name: Store name
create.countryHint: We set the currency, time zone and phone format from the country.

errors.tenantLimit: You have reached the store limit.
errors.generic: We couldn't create the store. Try again.

gate.unavailable: We can't reach your store right now.

palette.label: Search or jump to
palette.placeholder: Type a page or an action…

gallery.title: UI kit
gallery.subtitle: Every component of the dashboard, from the design system's recipes, in the current language and theme. Sample data only.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.body: One primary (ink) action per screen. Red only for the one commercial moment. Destructive actions ask first.

fields.title: Fields
fields.body: Label above, hint below; the error replaces the hint and says how to fix it.
fields.name: Store name
fields.phoneError: This number is too short. Egyptian mobiles have 11 digits.
fields.cityEmpty: No city matches. Check the spelling.
fields.autoConfirmHint: Orders with a risk under 40 skip the call.

statusSection.title: Status and payment
statusSection.body: Badges always carry words; colour is never the only signal. Payment methods are tags with their icon.

risk.label: Risk {score} of 100
risk.reasons: Two refused orders on this number in 60 days; address without a landmark.

kpis.title: Summary tiles
kpis.body: The hero tile is the number the screen exists for. Green and red follow meaning: a falling return rate is good news.

table.title: Table
table.body: Sticky header, sortable columns, row selection with bulk actions. Numbers at the end, ids left to right.
table.label: Sample orders

empty.title: No orders here
empty.body: Orders that need this step will show here as they arrive.
empty.returnsBody: When a courier brings a parcel back, it shows here for checking and restocking.

toast.shipped: {count, plural, one {# order shipped with Bosta} other {# orders shipped with Bosta}}

panel.title: Side panel
panel.body: Key facts as a label-value list and the history, newest first. Opens as a drawer on any screen.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.body: Alerts explain and suggest the next step. Toasts confirm what just happened. Loading shows the shape of the content.
feedback.success: We imported 412 orders from the last 60 days.
feedback.warningLead: 3 orders are waiting for a deposit.
feedback.warning: Send the link again or call the customer.
feedback.danger: The city is missing. Pick a city and send again.

dialog.title: Cancel order #{id}?
dialog.body: Bosta will be asked to stop the delivery, and the customer gets a WhatsApp message.

problems.network: No connection to the server. Check the internet and try again.
problems.generic: Something went wrong and we couldn't finish. Try again.

onboarding.title: Set up your store
onboarding.subtitle: Four steps to see your orders and your real profit in Mizan.

ready.title: Your store is ready.
ready.body: Orders arrive on their own from now on.

store.title: Connect your Shopify store
store.body: Mizan imports the last 60 days of orders and all your products, then receives every new order by itself.
store.hint: Write it as it appears in Shopify, like <n>nile-abayas.myshopify.com</n>.
store.importing: Importing: {orders} orders and {products} products so far…
store.invalid: That address doesn't look like a Shopify store. It ends with .myshopify.com.
store.scopesChanged: Mizan needs new Shopify permissions to edit orders (mark them paid and add offers the customer accepted). Approve them once.

courier.title: Connect your courier
courier.body: With Bosta connected, you ship confirmed orders in one click and their status updates by itself.
courier.hint: In Bosta: Settings → API integration → create a key, then paste it here.
courier.refused: Bosta refused this key. Copy it again from Bosta's dashboard and paste it here.
courier.noPermission: This key can't create or read deliveries. Create a key with full access in Bosta.
courier.skipped: Skipped. You can connect Bosta any time.

costs.title: Enter your product costs
costs.body: The cost of each product is what turns sales into real profit. Enter what one piece costs you.
costs.count: {missing} of {total} products have no cost yet.
costs.none: Your products show here after the store import.
costs.saved: {count, plural, one {Cost saved for # product} other {Costs saved for # products}}
costs.invalid: Write the cost as a number, like 250 or 250.50.
costs.skipped: Skipped. Profit uses a cost of zero until you enter it.

firstOrder.title: Your first order
firstOrder.waitingBody: As soon as an order reaches Mizan it shows here. New Shopify orders arrive within a minute.
firstOrder.ttfv: From signing up to your first order: {duration}.

errors.install_cancelled: The connection was cancelled in Shopify. Try again when you're ready.
errors.invalid_signature: Shopify's answer couldn't be verified. Start again from Mizan.
errors.invalid_state: This link expired. Start the connection again from Mizan.
errors.invalid_shop: That isn't a Shopify store address.
errors.scopes_missing: Mizan didn't get all the permissions it needs. Approve every permission in Shopify.
errors.shopify_unavailable: Shopify isn't answering right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.shopify_not_configured: Shopify isn't set up on this server yet.
errors.install_failed: The connection didn't finish. Try again.
errors.missing: This page needs a link from Shopify. Start the connection from Mizan.

orders.title: Orders
orders.subtitle: Every order from your stores in one list, newest first.
orders.search: Search by order number or customer phone
orders.label: Orders

empty.title: No orders yet
empty.body: Connect your store and your orders show here within a minute.

emptyTab.title: No orders here
emptyTab.body: Orders with this status show here as they arrive.

noMatch.title: No order matches
noMatch.body: Search by order number like #1042, or by the customer's phone.

notFound.title: Order not found
notFound.body: It may be in another store, or not one you can open.

payments.title: Payments
payments.empty: No money has moved on this order yet.

customer.title: Customer
customer.recorded: Viewing is recorded in the activity log.
customer.name: Name
customer.gone: These details were deleted on request.
customer.tooMany: Too many views in a short time. Try again in a minute.
customer.none: No customer details on this order.

risk.title: Risk
risk.notScored: Not scored yet. Scoring comes with confirmation.

confirmation.title: Confirmation

reason.no_reply: The customer didn't answer the automatic messages. Call them, or send the link again.
reason.no_channel: No WhatsApp, SMS or calls connected yet: send the link by hand.
reason.change_requested: The customer asked for a change. Call them.
reason.manual: Link sent by hand. Waiting for the customer.

confirmation.waiting: Waiting for an answer to {channel}, until
confirmation.noVendor: Automatic messages start when WhatsApp, SMS or calls are connected.
confirmation.noPhone: This order has no phone number.
confirmation.cancelBody: The order won't ship. The customer isn't notified automatically.

profit.title: Profit
profit.movingHint: Counted for real when the money arrives: on delivery for cash, on payment for prepaid.
profit.estimated: Courier and fee costs are estimates from your rates until the courier's settlement arrives.

missing.fx_missing: Exchange rate for this order's currency and day

costs.title: Costs
costs.subtitle: What each order costs beyond its products, so profit is real.
costs.versioning: Changes apply to orders from today (<d></d>). Older orders keep the cost of their day.
costs.readOnly: You can see costs; only the owner, an admin or finance can change them.

notAllowed.title: Costs are for owners and finance
notAllowed.body: Ask the store owner if you need to see them.

costs.saved: Saved. It applies to orders from today.
costs.invalidPercent: Enter a percentage like 1.5 (100 at most)

perOrder.title: Per order
perOrder.body: Costs every order carries, whatever is in it.
perOrder.agentHint: What one confirmed order costs in agent time or commission.

cod.title: Cash on delivery
cod.body: What the courier takes for collecting cash, as a share of the amount collected.

payment.title: Online payment fees
payment.body: What the gateway or wallet keeps per payment: a percentage plus a fixed amount.

courier.title: Courier rate card
courier.body: What each courier charges per delivery and per return. A zone rate wins over the courier's general rate.

monthly.title: Monthly fixed costs
monthly.body: Rent, salaries, subscriptions: spread over the month's orders in the profit view.
monthly.label: What it is

fx.title: Exchange rates
fx.body: Orders in another currency are converted with the rate of the day they were placed. Rates update daily; set your own for a day if your bank's differs.

confirm.title: Confirm your order
confirm.intro: Please confirm your order <n>{number}</n> so we can ship it.

location.share: Share my location for the courier
location.denied: Location wasn't shared. That's fine: the courier will call you.

confirm.changeLabel: What would you like to change?
confirm.privacy: Only you and the store can see this page.

invalid.title: This link doesn't work
invalid.body: Check the message you received, or contact the store.

failed.title: Something went wrong
failed.body: We couldn't load your order. Try again in a moment.

expired.body: This link has expired. The store will contact you.

confirmed.title: Order confirmed
confirmed.body: Thank you! {store} will ship your order soon.

cancelled.title: Order cancelled
cancelled.body: Your order was cancelled. Nothing will be shipped.

changed.title: We got your request
changed.body: {store} will call you shortly about the change.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.body: {store} will contact you to confirm your order.

closed.title: Nothing to confirm
closed.body: This order no longer needs your confirmation.

confirmationSettings.title: Confirmation
confirmationSettings.subtitle: How new cash-on-delivery orders get confirmed automatically, before an agent steps in.
confirmationSettings.loadFailed: Couldn't load the settings. Try again.
confirmationSettings.saved: Saved. New orders follow these settings.

notAllowed.title: For owners, admins and ops managers
notAllowed.body: Ask the store owner to change how orders are confirmed.

confirmationSettings.enabledHint: Each new order is asked to confirm on WhatsApp, then SMS, then an automatic call. Orders nobody answers go to an agent.

channels.title: Connected channels
channels.none: Nothing is connected yet, so new orders go straight to an agent, who sends the confirm link on WhatsApp with one tap. Connecting WhatsApp, SMS or calls makes it automatic.

steps.title: Order of steps
steps.body: Mizan tries each step in turn and waits for an answer before the next. A channel that isn't connected is skipped.

hours.title: Calling hours
hours.body: Automatic calls only happen in these hours, store time. Messages are sent any time.

link.hint: After that the customer is asked to wait for a call.
